artifact.name: compute_percentage_change
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local initial = input.initial_value
    local current = input.current_value

    if initial == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local function round2(n: number): number
        local sign = n < 0 and -1 or 1
        local absn = math.abs(n)
        local rounded = math.floor(absn * 100 + 0.5) / 100
        return rounded * sign
    end

    local raw_change = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
    local pct = round2(raw_change)

    local direction: string
    if current > initial then
        direction = "up"
    elseif current < initial then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percent change from initial to current, rounded to 2 decimals, with direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a rounded percentage change and direction (up/down/flat) between two numeric values.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- list customers in segment
    local list_res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if not list_res.ok then
        return { error = list_res.error, message = list_res.message }
    end

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local sends = 0
    for _, cust in list_res.customers do
        if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            if sends >= 10 then
                -- respect max 10 sends per execution
                break
            end
            local text = ("Hi %s, we miss you!"):format(cust.name)
            local send_res = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
            if not send_res.ok then
                table.insert(failed, cust.id)
            else
                table.insert(notified, cust.id)
            end
            sends += 1
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: List a segment's customers and message inactive ones up to 10 sends
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you want to notify customers in a segment who have been inactive for at least inactive_days

artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
local function round_to(n: number, decimals: number): number
    local factor = 10 ^ decimals
    if n >= 0 then
        return math.floor(n * factor + 0.5) / factor
    else
        return math.ceil(n * factor - 0.5) / factor
    end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local initial = input.initial_value
    local current = input.current_value

    if initial == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local raw_change = (current - initial) / initial * 100
    local pct = round_to(raw_change, 2)

    local direction: string
    if pct > 0 then
        direction = "up"
    elseif pct < 0 then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percentage change between two numbers rounded to 2 decimals and indicate direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need the percent change and whether a value moved up, down, or stayed flat.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- list customers in segment
    local res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if res.ok == false then
        return { error = res.error, message = res.message }
    end

    local customers: { CustomerRef } = res.customers
    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}

    -- send at most 10 messages
    local sends_allowed: number = 10
    for _, c in customers do
        if sends_allowed <= 0 then
            break
        end
        if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            local text = ("Hi {name}, we miss you!"):gsub("{name}", c.name)
            local r = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
            if r.ok == false then
                table.insert(failed, c.id)
            else
                table.insert(notified, c.id)
            end
            sends_allowed -= 1
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: List customers in a segment and message inactive ones (up to 10 sends).
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you want to reach out to customers in a segment who haven't been seen for >= inactive_days.
